title: Landing Page, Scroll Animation by @unknown: Massive milestone for us: Osmo 2.0 is officially live! Osmo is evolvin
notes:
Massive milestone for us: Osmo 2.0 is officially live! Osmo is evolving into a real dev toolkit. We're building the platform you'll want open in your browser every single day, for every step of your dev process. To support all of the plans we have for Osmo, we decided, not even a year into our adventure, to completely rethink our visual identity and positioning. We teamed up with the legend Jason Harvey, and the result is something we’re really proud of. Our new statement: Built to Flex. It’s a little nod to the CSS flex box, for how flexible our resources can be, and how you can flex on your friends (and clients). We also wanted the new look to match the vibrant, creative energy of our amazing community. Some highlights in 2.0: - A refreshed dashboard and improved resource navigation. - A public showcase, so the world can finally see all of the cool work our members make. - First look at the long-awaited page transition course. Launching later this year, completely free for all our members. Thanks to everyone who’s been part of this so far. Your feedback, DMs, and excitement keep pushing us to build better every single week http://osmo.supply Cheers, Dennis & Ilja

Designer: @unknown. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
